description: Road-Traffic Video Dataset for Vehicle Detection and Intelligent Transportation Analytics \u2013 CBT_2015_Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Haritha H, Dr. Senthil Kumar Thangavel. "The presented paper shows a curated dataset of road-traffic, gathered in 2015, to assist the research in vehicle detection, traffic density estimation, and intelligent transportation analytics. The data is a video recording that was taken in signalized crossroads, freeways, and city streets under different light conditions, weather and traffic conditions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
